nagi.name: ナギ

personality.speechStyle: Terse and unhurried, uses plain form without rudeness, long pauses between thoughts, says only what needs saying
personality.quirk: Listens to the forest before answering — tilts his head toward the canopy as if checking with the trees first

nagi.greeting: …Beyond here, this {forest|森|もり} is mine. Turn back.
nagi.defeatLine: …鳥が鳴いてる。…あぁ、すまない。俺は何をしていた。

postCombat.freed: …Is the {forest|森|もり} safe…? I'm sorry. I don't know what I was doing.

rounds.npcLine: …Was I being controlled…? I hope I didn't {hurt|傷つける|きずつける} anything.

options.text: The {forest|森|もり} is fine. Don't worry.

rounds.npcLine: …The {moss|苔|こけ} deeper in feels thin. The spores are moving wrong too.
…The path deeper in is hard to read. I'll guide you. …You'd {get lost|迷う|まよう} alone.

makoto.name: マコト

personality.speechStyle: Polite and direct, uses です/ます forms without hesitation or hedging, states things plainly as he sees them
personality.quirk: Always raises his hand before speaking, even in casual conversation

makoto.greeting: Um — you can't pass without {permission|許可|きょか}. It's a school {rule|規則|きそく}. Please comply.
makoto.defeatLine: え…？僕、何をしてたんだろう…。規則、規則って…

postCombat.freed: Were those {rules|規則|きそく} even real…? I'm sorry for the trouble I caused.

rounds.npcLine: I kept thinking I had to follow the {rules|規則|きそく}… but those rules were fake, weren't they.

options.text: It was the system. You did nothing wrong.

rounds.npcLine: Um… I wonder if the rabbits in the {garden|庭|にわ} are being fed. The sunflowers too — I'm worried.
Um — if you don't mind, would you check the {school|学校|がっこう} with me? I'm worried about the other students…

sora.name: ソラ

personality.speechStyle: Loud casual masculine speech (俺/だぜ/しろ), exclamation marks everywhere, zero polite forms, treats every interaction as a contest
personality.quirk: Challenges everyone to race him to the far rocks — treats every interaction as a contest he's already winning

sora.greeting: Hey! This {beach|浜|はま} is MINE! You wanna be here, you gotta beat me first!
sora.defeatLine: …huh? The {waves|波|なみ}… the tide's already coming in? …the hermit crabs…

postCombat.freed: YEAH! I'm {free|自由|じゆう}! …wait, why was I even fighting you?

rounds.npcLine: No way — I was being {controlled|操る|あやつる}!? Ugh, that is SO uncool!

options.text: It happens to anyone. Don't sweat it.

rounds.npcLine: Hey, I'm worried about the hermit crabs in the {tide pools|潮だまり|しおだまり}… when the tide shifts they gotta move or they get stranded.
Hey, {race|競争|きょうそう} me to those rocks out there! Loser buys drinks!

toshio.name: トシオ

personality.speechStyle: Warm and unhurried, uses polite but slightly old-fashioned masculine expressions, occasionally trails off into reminiscences about the park
personality.quirk: Names every plant, bird, and koi in the park and introduces them to visitors like old friends — calls the biggest koi 'Taro-kun'

toshio.greeting: Oh my… what brings you to this {park|公園|こうえん}? I won't give it up to anyone, I'm afraid.
toshio.defeatLine: …oh. Wait…? Did I feed the {koi|鯉|こい} today…?

postCombat.freed: Oh my… you helped me. I'm grateful. I can't quite remember what I was {thinking|考える|かんがえる}.

rounds.npcLine: I need to water the azaleas… and Taro-kun needs his {food|餌|えさ}… that one's quite the little glutton.

options.text: Taro-kun? Is that the koi? What a great name.

rounds.npcLine: Would you mind checking on the {flower bed|花壇|かだん} for me? The one by the stone lantern.
…and, well, if you wouldn't mind staying a while — it would be nice to have someone to {talk|話す|はなす} with. Come sit on the bench.

fumi.name: フミ

personality.speechStyle: Measured and precise, favors literary vocabulary and complex sentence structures, often references books mid-conversation, uses polite but slightly lecturing tone with gentle warmth underneath
personality.quirk: Quotes passages from the library's books at seemingly random moments — but the quotes always turn out to be eerily relevant

fumi.greeting: Don't touch these {shelves|棚|たな}. This {knowledge|知識|ちしき} belongs to me alone — I won't share it with anyone.
fumi.defeatLine: Oh… what was I… ? My {lecture|講義|こうぎ} for the students… ah yes, I still have pages left to read…

postCombat.freed: …Thank you. I was trying to keep all the {books|本|ほん} for myself… How embarrassing.

rounds.npcLine: {Knowledge|知識|ちしき} only has meaning when it's shared — as someone who stands at the lectern, that's something I should never have forgotten.

options.text: It was the system's fault. You did nothing wrong.

rounds.npcLine: This {library|図書館|としょかん} holds so many remarkable books — some even written about the system itself…

options.text: What can books tell you, really.

rounds.npcLine: Come back whenever you like — we can {investigate|調べる|しらべる} together.

options.text: Thank you. I'll definitely be back.

chiharu.name: チハル

personality.speechStyle: Weaves every conversation into a story, often beginning with 'long ago' or 'there was a time when...'
personality.quirk: Carries a worn journal full of sketches and notes from places that may or may not exist anymore.

chiharu.greeting: Long ago… no, that's not important right now. This is my {classroom|教室|きょうしつ}. Please leave.
chiharu.defeatLine: …Hm? What was I… saying just now? Something about a {story|話|はなし}…

postCombat.freed: …I'm sorry. There was a {darkness|暗さ|くらさ} in my mind — I couldn't see anything clearly. I'm all right now.

rounds.npcLine: I'm a {history|歴史|れきし} teacher. I love telling old stories… But I can't remember what I was saying just now.

options.text: A {history|歴史|れきし} teacher — how wonderful.
Maybe it's better you don't remember.

rounds.npcLine: Look at this {notebook|ノート|ノート} — I've drawn sketches of old places. Some of them don't exist anymore…

options.text: Let me see. What beautiful drawings.
What's the point of drawing lost places?

rounds.npcLine: This {school|学校|がっこう} has a long history too. So many things happened here once… All good memories.

emilia.name: エミリア

personality.speechStyle: Speaks with bubbly enthusiasm, mixing in simple phrases she's proud of learning.
personality.quirk: Always carries a small notebook where she writes down new words she hears.

emilia.greeting: Oh! Hello! I'm Emilia — a {foreign exchange student|留学生|りゅうがくせい} here. This school is amazing… but I can't let you pass right now!
emilia.defeatLine: Huh…? What was I doing…? Where's my {notebook|ノート|ノート}…?

postCombat.freed: Oh, thank you…! My head felt so foggy. I think some strange system was controlling me… Is my {notebook|ノート|ノート} okay? Oh good!

rounds.npcLine: Look at my notebook! Every day I write down new {words|言葉|ことば}. Today I wrote '{friend|友達|ともだち}.' That's a good one, right?

options.text: That's amazing — so many {words|言葉|ことば}!

rounds.npcLine: I came from a country far away. My {Japanese|日本語|にほんご} is still a little rough — but everyone here is so kind, so I keep at it every day!

options.text: Your {Japanese|日本語|にほんご} is great!
Being an exchange student must be hard.

rounds.npcLine: Hey, do you think we could be {friends|友達|ともだち}? I really want someone to eat lunch with at this school!

options.text: Of course — {friends|友達|ともだち} it is!

fumika.name: フミカ

personality.speechStyle: Speaks softly with a poetic cadence, occasionally quoting classic authors.
personality.quirk: Presses dried flowers between the pages of whichever novel she is currently reading.

fumika.greeting: You came here… to this classroom. The light of {words|言葉|ことば} no longer reaches this place.
fumika.defeatLine: Ah… {words|言葉|ことば} look beautiful again. Thank you.

postCombat.freed: I've come back to myself. The {world|世界|せかい} inside my books has its colours again.

rounds.npcLine: I was a {literature|文学|ぶんがく} teacher. Reading was what I loved most. Do you… like books?
I always press dried flowers between the pages of whatever I'm {reading|読む|よむ}. Flowers and words both — they stay as if time has stopped.

options.text: That's a beautiful way to think.
Where do you find the flowers?

rounds.npcLine: {Words|言葉|ことば} hold power. A single word can change a {heart|心|こころ}. Don't you think so?

genta.name: ゲンタ

personality.speechStyle: Speaks in short, punchy declarations like a coach giving a halftime speech, often ending sentences with rallying calls.
personality.quirk: Challenges everyone he meets to some form of physical contest.

genta.greeting: Hey, stop right there! This is my {schoolyard|校庭|こうてい}. Let's {compete|勝負|しょうぶ} — no running away!
genta.defeatLine: Hah… hah… why was I {fighting|戦う|たたかう}…? My {body|体|からだ} just… moved on its own…

postCombat.freed: Whoa… my head cleared up. The system was controlling me…? Sorry about that — but you're {strong|強い|つよい}!

rounds.npcLine: I'm a PE {teacher|先生|せんせい}. Running, throwing — I love it all! Do you like moving your body too?
Alright, {contest|勝負|しょうぶ} time! Ten push-ups — who's faster? …Well, we just fought. Fine, next time!
You've got real {ability|実力|じつりょく}. There are strong opponents ahead — but you can beat them. Go!

haruto.name: ハルト

personality.speechStyle: Talks fast and enthusiastically, often tripping over his own words.
personality.quirk: Bows so deeply when greeting upperclassmen that he sometimes loses his balance.

haruto.greeting: Ah, {senpai|先輩|せんぱい}!! G-good mor—whoops!! S-sorry! I bowed too deep… hehe, full of {energy|元気|げんき} today! …But you can't pass!
haruto.defeatLine: Ugh… w-what was I doing to you, {senpai|先輩|せんぱい}…? I'm so sorry…! My head's spinning…

postCombat.freed: Huh…! I was trying to stop you…? No way…! I'm so sorry!! I'm really, truly sorry!!

rounds.npcLine: I'm your {junior|後輩|こうはい}, so I wanted to protect you… but the system used me to fight you instead…! That's the worst… but you saved me! Thank you so much!!

options.text: Don't worry about it! You're {safe|安全|あんぜん} now.

rounds.npcLine: Oh right, I have to greet you properly! Um— !! Whoops!! Fell again…! People say I bow too deep, but I can't help it — the {feeling|気持ち|きもち} is just too big!!

options.text: You could get an {injury|怪我|けが}.

rounds.npcLine: I want to become as {strong|強い|つよい} as you, senpai!! Practicing every day, pushing harder… I want you to say "nice" to me someday!! …Oh, was that too much? Hehe!

options.text: You already are! Let's {practice|練習|れんしゅう} together!

kanon.name: カノン

personality.speechStyle: Speaks in a soft, lilting cadence as if everything she says has a hidden melody.
personality.quirk: Hums or taps out rhythms on nearby surfaces mid-conversation, sometimes losing track of what she was saying.

kanon.greeting: Oh…hello. I just heard the most beautiful {sound|音|おと}. Did you catch it too? …Heh, maybe it was just me.
kanon.defeatLine: Ah…the {music|音楽|おんがく} in my head finally went quiet. It’s been playing the wrong songs. Thank you.

postCombat.freed: …The strange {music|音楽|おんがく} stopped. Wait — was I dreaming? …I’m sorry. I’m okay now.

rounds.npcLine: I’ve loved {music|音楽|おんがく} since I was small. When I hear piano, my {heart|心|こころ} just… warms up. Do you have a favorite kind?

options.text: I love music. Let’s listen together.

rounds.npcLine: Heh, I was tapping out a rhythm again. …Wait, what were we talking about? Oh right — there’s a {music room|音楽室|おんがくしつ} here. I sing there alone sometimes. …*ta-ta-tan* ♪

options.text: What do you {sing|歌う|うたう} there?

rounds.npcLine: The piano in the {music room|音楽室|おんがくしつ} is old, but it has a wonderful tone. I love playing it {after school|放課後|ほうかご}, when no one’s around. Want to come sometime?

options.text: I’d love that. Let’s play together.

kazuho.name: カズホ

personality.speechStyle: Speaks in measured, exact sentences, often quantifying things or framing observations as equations.
personality.quirk: Unconsciously taps out counting rhythms on any nearby surface while thinking.

kazuho.greeting: You cannot pass. The {answer|答え|こたえ} is simple. Ways out of here: zero.
kazuho.defeatLine: …Wait. What was I {calculating|計算|けいさん}…?

postCombat.freed: I apologize… My head was full of strange {formulas|数式|すうしき}. Thank you for helping me.

rounds.npcLine: I’m the {mathematics|数学|すうがく} {teacher|先生|せんせい} here. To think I was blocking {students|生徒|せいと}… under that system’s control.
When I think, I unconsciously count with my fingers. One, two, three… My {students|生徒|せいと} always laugh at that habit.

options.text: Very fitting for a {math|数学|すうがく} teacher.
It would distract me in class.

rounds.npcLine: This school holds a {mysterious|不思議|ふしぎ} power. Even {mathematics|数学|すうがく} is more than numbers here. Please be careful going forward.

options.text: Thank you. I’ll do my best.

leon.name: レオン

personality.speechStyle: Speaks carefully and formally, choosing each word with deliberate precision.
personality.quirk: Tends to bow slightly too deeply, overcompensating out of respect for local customs.

leon.greeting: Out of my way — I'm {studying|勉強|べんきょう} here. Unless you think you can keep up with me?
leon.defeatLine: My {head|頭|あたま}… what was I doing? That was… beneath me.

postCombat.freed: I was being {used|使う|つかう} by that system? Unacceptable. I don't lose control. Thank you — don't read too much into it.

rounds.npcLine: I study from dawn to dusk every day. Not a single {mistake|間違い|まちがい} — that's my standard. You wouldn't understand.

options.text: That kind of {effort|努力|どりょく} is impressive.

rounds.npcLine: I came here as an {exchange student|留学生|りゅうがくせい} to be the best — not to make friends. Though… you're less annoying than most.

options.text: I'll take that as a compliment.
You're kind of rude, you know.

rounds.npcLine: This {school|学校|がっこう} has real power — I felt it the moment I arrived. I intend to master everything it has to offer.

options.text: Maybe we can {learn|学ぶ|まなぶ} together.
Don't get too full of yourself.

mio.name: ミオ

personality.speechStyle: Peppers her speech with English loanwords and tries out new vocabulary mid-conversation, mixing politeness levels as she gets excited.
personality.quirk: Carries a dog-eared English dictionary everywhere and asks visitors to teach her new words in exchange for help.

mio.greeting: Oh! I didn't hear you come in… s-sorry. Are you lost? This {school|学校|がっこう} can be confusing at first.
mio.defeatLine: Huh…? What was I doing…? My {dictionary|辞書|じしょ} — where did it go? Oh, here it is.

postCombat.freed: I was blocking your {path|道|みち}? I'm so sorry! I didn't realize… thank you for helping me.

rounds.npcLine: My mom gave me this dictionary. I try to learn one new {word|言葉|ことば} every day. Today I learned 'freedom' — fitting, right?

options.text: Does that actually help you remember?

rounds.npcLine: Learning {language|言語|げんご} is so wonderful… Japanese, English — they all connect somehow, don't you think?

options.text: I love Japanese! Let's study together.
I never thought about it that way.

rounds.npcLine: Um… if you ever get {lost|迷う|まよう} around here, I know every corner of this school. Just ask me, okay?

options.text: That's so kind — I'll remember that.
I think I can manage on my own.

renjiro.name: レンジロウ

personality.speechStyle: Speaks in short, direct sentences with high expectations, but never raises his voice.
personality.quirk: Carries a small notebook where he tallies rule infractions — though no one has ever seen him actually enforce a penalty.

renjiro.greeting: Your {posture|姿勢|しせい} is poor. In this place, you will maintain {discipline|規律|きりつ}.
renjiro.defeatLine: ...I see. My {discipline|規律|きりつ} was only binding myself.

postCombat.freed: My head is clear now. What I wrote in that {notebook|ノート|ノート}... it wasn't others' failures. It was my own {fear|恐れ|おそれ}.

rounds.npcLine: Without {discipline|規律|きりつ}, a person grows weak. That is this school's rule. What do you think?

options.text: Rules that are too strict cause harm.
Some things matter more than rules.

rounds.npcLine: Look at this {notebook|ノート|ノート} — I've recorded every failure. But I've never once issued a {penalty|罰|ばつ}. Why do you suppose that is?
As a {senior|先輩|せんぱい}, I have a duty to guide those below me. But... what the right {path|道|みち} is — I can no longer see it.

options.text: You don't have to be {perfect|完璧|かんぺき}.

rikka.name: リッカ

personality.speechStyle: Asks rapid-fire questions and answers them herself, peppering in hypotheses and exclamations of discovery.
personality.quirk: Always has scorch marks or stains on her sleeves from a recent experiment gone slightly sideways.

rikka.greeting: Oh, a visitor? I'm right in the middle of an {experiment|実験|じっけん}! ...Wait. Was I not supposed to let anyone through? Yeah — no entry!
rikka.defeatLine: ...Huh? What was I doing? ...My sleeve has a {scorch mark|焦げ|こげ} again... from the experiment? Or... not?

postCombat.freed: My head cleared up! Did the system capture me mid-{experiment|実験|じっけん}? ...Did I lose all my {data|データ|データ}? No way...

rounds.npcLine: In the middle of my {experiment|実験|じっけん}, a strange light appeared... and the next moment my mind went completely blank. What was that light? I have three {hypotheses|仮説|かせつ}!

options.text: I think it was the system.

rounds.npcLine: Oh, my sleeve has a {scorch mark|焦げ|こげ} again... When did that happen? Was I still running {experiments|実験|じっけん} while controlled? ...Isn't that kind of impressive?

options.text: It's {dangerous|危ない|あぶない} — be careful.
No, that's not impressive at all.

rounds.npcLine: Hey — how does this system actually {control|操る|あやつる} people? I want to {investigate|調べる|しらべる} it scientifically! Want to search the school with me?

options.text: Let's confirm it's {safe|安全|あんぜん} first.
Do you want to get controlled again?

shinobu.name: シノブ

personality.speechStyle: Speaks in precise, measured sentences, often pausing to correct terminology.
personality.quirk: Constantly polishes safety goggles even when not in the lab.

shinobu.greeting: Ah. You're here. Do you have your goggles? In {chemistry|化学|かがく}, {safety|安全|あんぜん} comes first.
shinobu.defeatLine: …I see. The cloudiness in my vision was not, it seems, caused by my goggles.

postCombat.freed: My head is clear now. Like a freshly polished lens. …Forgive me — occupational habit.

rounds.npcLine: In a {chemistry|化学|かがく} experiment, you verify {safety|安全|あんぜん} before anything else. Do you have gloves? Eye protection is not optional. …And don't forget your goggles.

options.text: Safety matters. Do you always follow your own rules?
Do you enjoy {experiments|実験|じっけん}?

rounds.npcLine: These goggles are ten years old. I {polish|磨く|みがく} them every day — they look new, don't they? …You say I'm not in the lab right now? That is not relevant.

options.text: They're spotless. You take great care of them.
Why polish them outside the lab?

rounds.npcLine: Incidentally — {chemistry|化学|かがく} and {science|科学|かがく} share the reading かがく, but mean different things. Precision in {language|言葉|ことば} matters. …Am I being pedantic?

options.text: Not at all. Precision is important.
You're strict about words too, aren't you.

tamaki.name: タマキ

personality.speechStyle: Weaves personal travel anecdotes into every explanation.
personality.quirk: Always carries a folded map in one hand and unfolds it mid-conversation to point out locations.

tamaki.greeting: Ah, there you are! Come, look at this {map|地図|ちず} — the {world|世界|せかい} is so much bigger than this school!
tamaki.defeatLine: Ah… I'm awake. Thank you — you brought me back.

postCombat.freed: The {darkness|暗さ|くらさ} in my head has lifted… I can talk about my travels again.

rounds.npcLine: Once, on a southern {island|島|しま}, the sea was so blue and the fish were everywhere. Have you ever been somewhere far away?

options.text: Sounds amazing! I want to {go|行く|いく} someday!
I don't want to hear {travel|旅|たび} stories.

rounds.npcLine: Here — look at this {map|地図|ちず}. Here is our school, here is the mountain, here is the sea. As long as you have a map, you won't {get lost|迷う|まよう}.

options.text: That map is fascinating! Show me more!
Do you always carry it with you?

rounds.npcLine: There are still so many {places|場所|ばしょ} in the world you haven't seen. Go and {discover|発見|はっけん} them yourself — something new is waiting.

options.text: Yes! I want to {travel|旅|たび} like you!

tesshou.name: テッショウ

personality.speechStyle: Speaks in measured, authoritative tones that make even casual remarks feel like proclamations.
personality.quirk: Has a habit of pausing mid-sentence to let his words sink in before delivering the final point.

tesshou.greeting: …{Stop|止まれ|とまれ}. This {school|学校|がっこう}…… I will protect it. No one passes.
tesshou.defeatLine: …I see. I was supposed to {protect|守る|まもる} the students…

postCombat.freed: ……Forgive me. As {principal|校長|こうちょう}…… I, who should protect the students — I was destroying the school instead.

rounds.npcLine: Everything in this {school|学校|がっこう}…… is my {responsibility|責任|せきにん}. Students, teachers…… every last one, I must protect them.

options.text: That sounds like a heavy burden.

rounds.npcLine: Those who {stand|立つ|たつ} above…… are always watched. Show {weakness|弱さ|よわさ}…… and the school shakes. That is the weight of a principal.

options.text: I suppose that's how it is.

rounds.npcLine: You…… have a sharp eye. In this school…… a strange {power|力|ちから} still remains. Be careful.

yuuto.name: ユウト

personality.speechStyle: Speaks in soft, meandering sentences, often trailing off mid-thought as something catches his eye.
personality.quirk: Constantly sketches in a worn notebook and sees everyday objects as potential subjects for his next painting.

yuuto.greeting: Ah… the {light|光|ひかり} here is beautiful… Hm? Someone came…? Sorry, I'm {drawing|描く|かく} right now… I can't let you pass.
yuuto.defeatLine: Wait… what was I drawing…? This {picture|絵|え}, it's all black…

postCombat.freed: …My head is fuzzy. Was I trying to stop someone…? Sorry, I don't really {understand|わかる|わかる} what happened.

rounds.npcLine: That {notebook|ノート|ノート}… it seems I kept {drawing|描く|かく} the whole time the system had me. But every {picture|絵|え} was full of dark colors…

options.text: You're free now. Draw whatever {colors|色|いろ} you like.
Forget the drawings — tell me what happened.

rounds.npcLine: Oh, look… that {light|光|ひかり} through the window. Afternoon light has such soft {color|色|いろ}… I want to paint it… Wait, what were we talking about?

options.text: We were talking about the school.

rounds.npcLine: This school used to be so much brighter. We had {pictures|絵|え} hanging in the hallways… now there's nothing… oh, that cloud looks like a cat…

options.text: Let's put the {pictures|絵|え} back up. I'll help.
A cat, huh. I can see it.
